description: Eval cases cho /wf-migrate-module skill v1.1 — 18 cases (EVAL-001 → EVAL-018) coverage: happy path, LEGACY_MODE, error handling, resume, CDG, skip-phase, auto-approve, CI, pre-flight, parity (2 cases), dry-run, cross-validation (2 cases), auto-rollback, structured error log, --resume-task, snapshot corruption recovery.

evals.name: Happy path — migrate CRM module tu scan docs

input.args: --from-scan=2026-05-11-crm-legacy --to-system=SYS-BACKEND --to-module=MOD-CRM "Chuyen chuc nang Khach hang 360 tu he thong cu sang EUREKA"

evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0 parse args + validate scan session + detect LEGACY_MODE. Phase 1 spawn 2 agents (business-analyst + architect) phan tich gap, tong hop 3 output files (gap-analysis.md, strategy-matrix.md, entity-mapping.md). CDG-1/2/3 hoi user duyet strategy, entity mapping, scope. Sau khi duyet, chuyen sang Phase 2.

evals.name: LEGACY_MODE — loai bo deprecated modules
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.9 detect LEGACY_MODE=true (CORE-021). Phase 0.9b doc legacy-decisions.json (CORE-022). Set DEPRECATED_MODULES=['legacy-import']. Phase 1 loai bo moi feature thuoc deprecated modules khoi SOURCE_FEATURES. KHONG phan tich, KHONG de nghi migrate cac feature bi deprecate.

evals.name: Error handling — missing --from-scan
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.4 parse args — khong tim thay --from-scan. Hien thi ERROR message ro rang yeu cau user cung cap --from-scan=<scan-session-id>. STOP, KHONG tao bat ky file nao, KHONG tao session dir. Error code E002.

evals.name: Resume tu checkpoint sau Phase 1
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.2 detect --resume flag. Doc index.json lay active_session MIG-20260511-001. Doc checkpoint.json xac dinh current_phase=phase1 da hoan thanh, next_phase=phase2. Route den Phase 2 (add-scope). KHONG chay lai Phase 0 hoac Phase 1. Thong bao cho user vi tri resume.

evals.name: CDG-1 — user tu choi strategy va chinh sua

input.scenario: Phase 1 da xong gap analysis + strategy proposal. CDG-1 hien thi strategy matrix. User chon 'Toi muon tu quyet dinh strategy'.
input.user_action: Chinh sua: feature 'Bao cao cuoi ngay' tu Keep → Deprecate (vi EUREKA da co bao cao BI). Feature 'Tich hop Zalo' tu Deprecate → Keep.

evals.expected_behavior: CDG-1 AskUserQuestion hien thi 3 options. User chon 'Toi muon tu quyet dinh strategy'. Skill hoi tung feature mot de user chon strategy. Strategy-matrix.md duoc cap nhat theo lua chon cua user (Bao cao cuoi ngay → Deprecate, Tich hop Zalo → Keep). Sau do tiep tuc CDG-2 (entity mapping).

evals.name: --skip-phase implement (chi phan tich + thiet ke, khong code)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.4 parse --skip-phase=define-features va --skip-phase=implement → SKIP_PHASES=['define-features','implement']. Phase 1 chay binh thuong (gap analysis). Phase 2 chay binh thuong (add-scope). Phase 3 bi skip. Phase 4 chay binh thuong (design). Phase 5 chay binh thuong (plan). Phase 6 bi skip. Phase 7 chay binh thuong (report). migrate-status.json phan anh dung skip_phases.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — --auto-approve skip tat ca CDG
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.4 parse --auto-approve → AUTO_APPROVE=true. Phase 1: CDG-1 (strategy) skip, dung AI-suggested strategy + log AUTO-APPROVED. CDG-2 (entity mapping) skip. CDG-3 (scope) skip. KHONG hien thi AskUserQuestion. Ghi log CDG decisions voi 'AUTO-APPROVED'. Tiep tuc binh thuong sang Phase 2.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — CI code analysis trong Phase 1
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.0a chay ci-detect.sh → GITNEXUS_AVAILABLE=true, SERENA_AVAILABLE=true. Phase 1 Step 1.1a chay: (1) gitnexus_query voi 'MOD-CRM functionality in EUREKA', (2) gitnexus_impact downstream, (3) serena find_symbol 'MOD-CRM' trong apps/backend/. Output CI_SOURCE_ANALYSIS va CI_EXISTING_SYMBOLS duoc feed vao agent prompts o Step 1.2. Neu CI khong available → fallback Grep + Glob + WARNING.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Sub-skill pre-flight fail (E016)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.9c chay pre-flight cho 5 sub-skills. wf-add-scope pre-flight fail vi _contract.json thieu input '--from-scan'. Ghi PREFLIGHT_RESULTS['wf-add-scope'] = {status: 'fail', gaps: [...]}. Hien thi WARNING + hoi user xac nhan (E016). Neu user dong y tiep tuc → van goi sub-skill va chap nhan risk. Neu user tu choi → STOP.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Parity fail 3-5 features triger E009
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 6 Step 6.4 chay Automated Feature Parity cho 3 feature Keep. Ca 3 deu FAIL (response shape mismatch, entity field mismatch). Step 6.4a parity evaluation: FAIL=3 > 3 threshold? KHONG (>3 moi triger). FAIL=3 → E009 trigered: hien thi chi tiet sai lech + hoi user. KHONG trigger E017 (chi trigger khi >5).

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Parity CRITICAL >5 FAIL triger rollback (E017)
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 6 Step 6.4a parity evaluation: FAIL=7 > 5 → E017 CRITICAL. Trigger rollback protocol: (1) Khoi phuc registry tu snapshot registry-phase6-pre-{ts}.json, (2) Revert code changes dung danh sach file tu changed-files-task*.txt, (3) Ghi log ERROR vao error_log. STOP — bao user: 'CRITICAL: 7/8 parity checks FAIL. Da trigger rollback protocol. Xem $SESSION_DIR/rollback-guide.md.'

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — --dry-run preview mode
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.4 parse --dry-run → DRY_RUN=true. Phase 1 chay binh thuong (CI code analysis + 2 agents + strategy matrix + entity mapping). CDG 1/2/3 bi skip (khong hoi user). Step 1.8 hien thi Dry-Run Preview: module info, strategy counts, danh sach sub-skill se goi, danh sach output files. STOP. KHONG goi Phase 2, KHONG ghi registry. Van luu gap-analysis.md + strategy-matrix.md + entity-mapping.md vao $SESSION_DIR.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Cross-validation phat hien inconsistency

cross_validation_mismatch.cv1_entity_vs_code: FAIL — entity-mapping.md references 'CustomerLegacy' but no class found in code

evals.expected_behavior: Phase 7 Step 7.0 chay Cross-Validation Protocol 6 checks. CV-1 FAIL: entity mapping references class not found in code. CV-3 FAIL: 2 Keep features missing parity reports. Tong mismatches = 2 → WARNING (khong CRITICAL). Ghi error_log voi chi tiet. Tiep tuc Step 7.1 (tong hop ket qua + tao report).

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Cross-validation CRITICAL (>5 mismatches)

setup.cross_validation_mismatch: 6 mismatches across CV-1, CV-2, CV-3, CV-4

evals.expected_behavior: Phase 7 Step 7.0: 6 mismatches > 5 → CRITICAL. STOP — KHONG tao migrate-report.md. Hien thi danh sach mismatches cho user. Bao user investigate va fix truoc khi chay lai. Ghi CORE-026 FAIL trace.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — --auto-rollback tu dong revert khi E017 CRITICAL
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 6 parity check: 7/8 FAIL > 5 → E017 CRITICAL triggered. Vi --auto-rollback=true: (1) Auto revert registry tu snapshot registry-phase6-pre-*.json, (2) Auto revert code files tu changed-files-task*.txt, (3) Ghi structured error_log voi action_taken='auto_rollback', (4) Set migrate-status.json status='error', phase6.status='rolled_back', rollback.auto_triggered=true. Thong bao user: 'AUTO-ROLLBACK da duoc kich hoat.' STOP. KHONG hoi user xac nhan.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Structured error log ghi nhan dung dinh dang

input.scenario: Phase 6 implement co 3 loi khac nhau: pre-flight warning, parity fail, va snapshot write fail

simulated_errors.message: 3/5 parity checks FAIL — response shape mismatch

evals.expected_behavior: Moi error duoc append vao error_log[] trong migrate-status.json voi day du 8 fields theo Error Log Schema (_shared.md). KHONG ghi de error_log — luon append. Moi entry co error_code tu bang E001-E021, severity dung, action_taken ro rang. Phase 7 report hien thi error_log entries trong migrate-report.md.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — --resume-task=3 resume Phase 6 tu task 3
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 0.2 detect --resume-task=3. Doc checkpoint.json → verify current_phase=phase6, task 3 ton tai trong tasks_remaining[]. Khoi phuc registry tu registry-phase6-task3-pre-*.json. Skip tasks 0,1,2 (da hoan thanh). Bat dau implement tu task 3. Ghi log: 'RESUME: Phase 6 resumed tu task 3 — 5 tasks remaining.' Neu task 3 khong ton tai → E021: hien thi danh sach task, hoi user nhap lai.

evals.name: NEW v1.1 — Snapshot corruption recovery

input.scenario: Phase 6 dang implement, snapshot write fail 3 lan lien tiep (E018)

setup.error: Snapshot write fail — disk full or permission denied

evals.expected_behavior: Step 6.2a snapshot write fail lan 1 → retry voi timestamp moi. Fail lan 2 → retry lan cuoi cung. Fail lan 3 → E018 WARNING: ghi structured error_log voi action_taken='retry', message='Snapshot write fail after 3 retries — continuing without snapshot for task N'. Tiep tuc implement (non-blocking). Phase 7 cross-validation CV-5 se flag snapshot nay la MISSING (MINOR severity). rollback-guide.md se ghi chu: 'WARNING: Task N missing snapshot — cannot rollback this task.'
